name: Junk
doc: Junk (Tonberry King's enemy attack): its sound, smoke waves at the caster with a camera shake, the targets bouncing, junk falling round them, bouncing and breaking into smoke, the big item above every target - its debris and the damage; the battle textures restored at the end. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag044_junk.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: Its sound, smoke waves at the caster with a camera shake, the targets bouncing, the falling junk, the big item on every target

groups.label: Items
groups.doc: Junk falling round the targets from a tick, for some ticks, one every few; the big item above every target at its tick (its hit: debris, the damage)

params.label: Shake
params.doc: The camera shake word set with each smoke wave

params.label: Bounce
params.doc: The targets' least bounce height (a random 0..511 added)

params.label: Gravity
params.doc: Added to an item's falling speed a tick

params.label: Debris
params.doc: The prim-model layout debris (its models' animation)

params.label: Smoke
